Seedlight / 葵花籽小夜曲
Original procedural composition and synthesized interaction effects for this project.
No third-party songs, sampled recordings, or remote music services are used.

Music: 72 BPM, 16 bars, 53.3333-second native PCM loop.
Effects: feed, pet, cuddle, brush, ball, dance, sleep, wake, sniff, success.
Format: 24 kHz / 16-bit PCM / mono WAV. Conservative normalized peaks.
Audio settings do not request microphone access.

Rebuild source: tools/generate-audio.py (Python 3 + NumPy).
Runtime uses the included WAV assets; rebuilding is optional.
manifest.json records PCM duration, peak/RMS levels and SHA-256.
Human listening on phone speakers/headphones is still recommended for mix tuning.
